title: 第2964章 拿下第2970章 皇宫大殿内的夜空
slug: 万倍返还我收徒百无禁忌
content_zh:
如此近的距离，如此突兀。
对于注意力基本都放在后方九代战神和金色铠甲巨人上的紫鬼而言，完全超出预料。
等他警报在他心头骤起瞬间，四股聚合在一起的半步万道境攻势，已扑面而至。
仓促之间，紫鬼只来及猛地释放出一股大道力抵挡。
但这股大道力瞬间就被吞没，四股聚合在一起的半步万道境攻势同时轰在他身上。
紫色朦胧气体被划开，露出的残破大道躯，瞬间被千疮百孔。
大道血不要钱的在虚空间疯狂溅洒。
“嗬啊啊啊啊————”
凄厉惨叫声响彻虚空。
然而纵使在这样被攻势侵蚀之间，紫鬼仍顶着万分痛苦，试图将身上一部分大道躯自爆，再次形成此前那样的紫色朦胧气体大雾。
但全程顶着他一举一动的张云，哪会让他得逞？
九代战神与金色盔甲巨人第一时间得到张云指令，在紫鬼试图再次自爆部分大道躯的瞬间，一柄金色巨剑直接刺入。
噗！
剑尖当场贯穿紫鬼的大道躯。
紫鬼的自爆动作直接被打断，还来不及有下一步动作，九代战神到了。
那双手如同一道枷锁，直接锁住了紫鬼整个脖颈。
瞬间将紫鬼身上流转的大道力，封禁入对方体内，形成一道真的大道枷锁将对方封禁。
而后九代战神用力将之提起，扔至上空。
一只带着无尽寒气的彩色大手，一把抓住了紫鬼的残破大道躯，瞬间将之冻成了一具冰雕。
“带回来！”

张云淡淡的声音传来，一股传送能量落向九代战神、金色铠甲巨人以及正抓住冰雕的战天七。
这第三位半步万道境，正是神霄之云战天七。
此前的9999道级，只是吞噬融合了十团几个团的战天七。但如果吞噬融合的对象，变成四位战神级和多位巅峰9999道级的话……
那战天七，自然不再是9999道级，而是眼前的半步万道境！
当然，这是在张云完全掌控仙师大世界后，给战天七进行了一番升级后的成果。
战天七作为多道神霄之云的融合体，其中占据主导的神霄之云，是出自仙师大世界。
这道神霄之云早已经过造物祖师的改造，可以称得上是仙师大世界的造物之一。
因此在融合其他神霄之云后，是可以进行一次整合升级的。
张云之前没掌控仙师大世界，还没这方面权限。
但在掌控仙师大世界后，就动用其中的造物大道力，助战天七完成升级。
这一次升级，主要是拓宽了战天七吞噬融合的极限。
原先，吞噬融合一位巅峰9999道级强者，对于战天七都够呛。
但如今，哪怕是战神级其也能吞噬融合。
至于半步万道境，张云也拿九代战神试过。
吞噬融合没问题，只是融合之后，战天七的意识会被九代战神抢夺。
简单来说就是，吞噬融合后，谁为主就不知道了。
不过这对张云来说没什么影响。
毕竟九代战神的意识和战天七的意识谁主导，都会听他命令。
但吞噬融合后的效果并不好。
主要是实力没有提升，仍就是九代战神的半步万道境。哪怕中间张云让白鬼府府主、符剑鬼府府主等战神级加入融合，也无法带来提升。

半步万道境，显然是一个极限。
换句话说，没有万道境名额，半步万道境就是极限！
content_en:
So close, so abrupt.
For Zigui, who basically focused his attention on the ninth generation war god and the golden armored giant behind him, this was completely beyond expectations.
The moment the alarm suddenly sounded in his mind, four half-step Ten Thousand Dao Realm offensives gathered together were already coming towards him.
In a hurry, Zigui only had time to release a burst of great power to resist.
But this great power was swallowed up in an instant, and four half-step Ten Thousand Dao Realm offensives gathered together hit him at the same time.
The purple hazy gas was cut open, revealing the broken body that was instantly riddled with holes.
The blood of the avenue is splashed crazily in the virtual space for free.
"Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh"
The screams echoed through the void.
However, even though he was being eroded by this offensive, Zigui still endured extreme pain and tried to self-destruct part of his body, forming the same purple hazy gas fog again.
But Zhang Yun, who resisted his every move throughout the whole process, how could he let him succeed?
The Ninth Generation God of War and the golden-armored giant received Zhang Yun's instructions immediately. When the purple ghost tried to self-destruct part of the great body again, a golden giant sword pierced directly.
puff!
The tip of the sword penetrated the purple ghost's body on the spot.
Zi Gui's self-destruction action was directly interrupted, and before he could make the next move, the ninth generation war god arrived.
Those hands were like shackles, directly locking Zi Gui's entire neck.
Instantly, the power of the great power flowing in the purple ghost's body was sealed into the opponent's body, forming a true shackles of the great avenue to seal the opponent.
Then the ninth generation war god lifted it up with force and threw it into the sky.
A big colorful hand filled with endless coldness grabbed the broken body of the purple ghost and instantly froze it into an ice sculpture.
"Bring it back!"
Zhang Yun's faint voice came, and a burst of teleportation energy fell towards the ninth generation war god, the golden armored giant, and Zhan Tianqi who was grabbing the ice sculpture.
This third half-step Ten Thousand Dao Realm is none other than Shen Xiao Yun Zhan Tian Qi.
The previous 9999 Dao level only swallowed up Zhan Tianqi, who had merged several dozen regiments. But if the target of the fusion is swallowed and turned into four God of War level and multiple peak 9999 level...
That Zhan Tianqi is naturally no longer at the 9999th level, but at the half-step Ten Thousand Dao level in front of him!
Of course, this was the result of Zhang Yun's upgrades to Zhan Tianqi after he took full control of the Immortal Master World.
Zhan Tianqi is a fusion of multiple divine clouds, among which the dominant divine cloud comes from the Great World of Immortal Masters.
This divine cloud has already been transformed by the founder of creation, and can be regarded as one of the creations of the world of immortal masters.
Therefore, after integrating other Shenxiao Clouds, an integration upgrade can be performed.
Zhang Yun had not controlled the Immortal Master World before and had no authority in this regard.
But after taking control of the Immortal Master World, he used the power of creation to help Tianqi complete the upgrade.
This upgrade mainly broadens the limits of Zhan Tianqi's devouring and fusion capabilities.
It turned out that swallowing and merging a peak 9999 level powerhouse was enough for Zhan Tianqi.
But now, even the God of War level can swallow and fuse.
As for the Half-Step Ten Thousand Dao Realm, Zhang Yun also tried it with the Ninth Generation God of War.
There is no problem with swallowing and fusion, but after the fusion, Zhan Tianqi's consciousness will be snatched away by the ninth generation war god.
To put it simply, after devouring and merging, you won’t know who is in charge.
But this has no impact on Zhang Yun.
After all, whoever dominates the consciousness of the Nine Generations God of War or Zhan Tianqi will obey his orders.
But the effect after devouring the fusion is not good.
The main reason is that his strength has not improved, and he is still at the half-step Ten Thousand Dao realm of the Ninth Generation God of War. Even if Zhang Yun lets the Lord of the White Ghost Palace, the Lord of the Fujian Ghost Palace and other God-of-War levels join in the fusion, it will not bring improvement.
Half a step to the Ten Thousand Dao Realm is obviously a limit.
In other words, if there is no quota for the Ten Thousand Dao Realm, half a step to the Ten Thousand Dao Realm is the limit!
